knownRisks: 🔴 A CDP GUARD THAT *FAILS* THE TAURI IPC FETCH REFUSES NOTHING - IT IS A RETRY, AND IT BLINDS ITSELF PERMANENTLY. Found by GATE 4 round 12 on 2026-09-17, and it is the THIRD instance of this class in this project. The round-11 entry below records the first shape (assigning onto window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke is a silent no-op) and the fix it recommended - guard at the CDP transport - is what round 12 built first, exactly as specified.
